name: verify-integrate
deprecation_criterion: Superseded when the loop adopts a non-git VCS backend, or a model-backed verify/integrate policy replaces the deterministic gh-based gates, or when the Verdict / IntegrationResult / ReviewVerdict / ReconcileResult schemas reach a breaking major version.
spec_change_reason: v0.25.4 REVIEW scope-narrowing: the auto-maintainer-reviewer (REVIEW state) was observed live filing a cross-PR finding ('PR #x version bump 0.3.4 collides with sibling #y') that races RECONCILE and duplicates the VERIFY/INTEGRATE merge gates. FIX (agent-prose behavior narrowing, no schema/gating change): ship/agents/auto-maintainer-reviewer.md gains a prominent 'Scope boundary' EXCLUSION section — the reviewer judges ONLY the logical/functional/quality of THIS PR's own base..head diff and MUST NOT emit any finding about merge conflicts, rebase/mergeability state (CONFLICTING/UNKNOWN), version-bump or shared-file collisions between this and sibling/other open loop PRs, or ANY cross-PR/merge-state concern (owned deterministically by RECONCILE + the VERIFY/INTEGRATE merge gates). It never looks at sibling PRs. Severity floor + review_findings OUTPUT contract + advisory/non-gating REVIEW are UNCHANGED. spec.md + contract.md scope-boundary paragraph/invariant/exclusion already committed at f229486; housekeep doc baseline re-anchored (spec.md 553 -> 569). PRIOR v0.25.3 hotfix: RECONCILE's (B) conflict-recovery ladder silently missed a genuinely-conflicting loop PR because gh_pr_state_source did not resolve a transient mergeable=UNKNOWN (VERIFY's gh_open_pr_source got that poll in v0.25.1). Right after a sibling PR merges and invalidates a loop PR, GitHub reports mergeable=UNKNOWN transiently, so _reconcile_one's (B) branch (which requires mergeable=='CONFLICTING' exactly) skipped it. FIX: gh_pr_state_source(pr_ref, repo, runner, sleep) now, when the PR is OPEN and NOT merged and mergeable=='UNKNOWN', calls the EXISTING poll_mergeability(number, repo, runner, sleep) — the same bounded poll VERIFY uses (MERGEABILITY_POLL_ATTEMPTS / MERGEABILITY_POLL_INTERVAL_S) — to re-query until the value settles to MERGEABLE/CONFLICTING or the bounded attempts exhaust, returning that settled mergeable. A MERGED PR short-circuits (no poll — merge state is final); a still-UNKNOWN result is returned as-is (defers to the next tick). _reconcile_one and the (A)/(B)/(C) logic are UNCHANGED — the seam now returns a settled value; RECONCILE stays advisory + fault-isolated. Housekeep doc baseline re-anchored (spec.md 537 -> 553).
spec_no_change_reason: spec.md + contract.md scope-boundary exclusion already committed this cycle at f229486; this TDD cycle implements the agent-prose narrowing + re-anchors the housekeep doc baseline
